I've set up a $300 contract with Lina in two parts: $120 for 3 or more logo concepts, then $180 for the final logo files (vector and PNG files, color versions, fonts and color codes). I used "Bakery Owner" as your name and "Lina" as hers, since I only had her email. To fund it, open this PayPal link: https://www.sandbox.paypal.com/checkoutnow?token=7J922860K1007472H — PayPal holds the money and only pays her as each part is approved, and she should start once it's funded.
